nodes.label: Time-varying intervention matrix
nodes.rationale: Apply proportional hazard reductions after diffusion normalization so removed infectiousness is not redistributed to other recipients.

nodes.label: Pairwise diffusion weights
nodes.rationale: Multiply attribute-specific weights, exclude self-transmission, and default to equal weights for distinct pairs when diffusion matrices are absent.

nodes.label: Bernoulli infection sampling
nodes.rationale: Sample infection independently for each susceptible present individual with probability 1-exp(-H_j(t)); individuals can be infected only once.

nodes.label: Hazard-weighted source assignment
nodes.rationale: Assign a previously infected infectious source with probability h_ij(t)/H_j(t); initial cases have no assigned source.
nodes.source_location: Infection and source assignment: Pr(source=i | j infected on day t)

nodes.label: Normalized infectiousness allocation
nodes.rationale: Normalize separately for each source over every other present individual, including previously infected individuals; use zero when the denominator is zero.

nodes.label: Admission and discharge presence
nodes.rationale: Individuals are present from admission inclusive until discharge exclusive.

nodes.label: Simultaneous daily infection updates
nodes.rationale: Update infection states simultaneously at each day's end so newly infected individuals begin transmitting on the following day.

nodes.label: Incremental graph update
nodes.rationale: Run graphify update . after code modifications to keep the graph current using AST-only extraction without API cost.

nodes.label: Scoped graph navigation
nodes.rationale: Query, path and explain return scoped subgraphs, usually much smaller than the full report or raw grep output.
